title: Fix duplicate Process Metrics section in SIPOC form
description: The sipoc-form.tsx component contains two identical 'Process Metrics' sections (with heading 'Process Metrics' and fields for Cycle Time, Lead Time, and Value Add %). The first section (around line 128) uses a simpler layout with small text/inputs, while the second section (around line 161) uses a more polished layout with relative-positioned unit labels (min, min, %). The duplicate first section should be removed, keeping only the second, better-designed version. This is a clear bug that results in redundant form fields shown to the user.
